description: Record a finding about an engine bridge into .unikit/bridge-notes/<bridge>.md — the project's log of what has to be re-checked there. Use right after a call reported success while changing nothing, ate an argument, or validated a broken state, e.g. "write this down", "record this bridge finding", "the server lied — note it", "add a recheck note", "trap this". Input: the finding in one line, a path to a plan file (harvests the "## Engine Bridge Findings" table of that plan and nothing else), or nothing at all — then it takes findings already in the session first, and offers to scan the tables of plans touched since the last audit. The table only, never the plan body. Each finding goes to the notes of the bridge it came through. Writes in the one allowed genre — a check to perform; never a lifted gate, never a named workaround, never a claim about what a bridge can or cannot do. Makes zero bridge calls and needs no editor. To replay, retire, or upstream existing notes use /unikit-bridge-audit instead.
